name: Omarchy Screenshot Manager
author: Sahzudin Mahmic
description: Browse, preview, copy, and delete screenshots taken with omarchy capture.

barWidget.description: List, preview, copy, and delete screenshots

schema.label: Show screenshot count
schema.description: The number of screenshots, beside the camera. Off leaves the glyph alone, which is the version to run when the folder is somewhere you pass through rather than somewhere you keep count of.

schema.label: Highlight new screenshots
schema.description: Colours the camera in the theme accent once a screenshot has been taken that you have not opened the manager for, and drops it back the moment you click it. Nothing is added beside the glyph, so the row of icons stays the shape it was. Off by default because it costs a small directory scan every few seconds; nothing runs at all until you switch it on.
